entries.headline: Civil airliner escorted to Nuremberg after 7500 squawk
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a DW report that a civil airliner over Germany accidentally transmitted squawk code 7500, was escorted by German Air Force aircraft to Nuremberg Airport, and was met by police.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo aircraft and elevated Korea-Japan activity
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and military flight activity near Korea and Japan at nearly five times normal.

entries.headline: USAF transports and elevated Korea-Japan activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple large US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the United States and Europe, with activity near Korea and Japan at nearly 4.5 times normal.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo aircraft and support activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne over the continental United States and North Sea, alongside multiple refueling tankers and surveillance aircraft tracked during the day.

entries.headline: Six USAF transports amid elevated flight activity
entries.summary: War Watch reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States as military flight activity ran nearly 3.3 times above normal.

entries.headline: Elevated Black Sea activity and US transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported air activity near the Black Sea at nearly three times normal and US military transport aircraft active over the continental United States.

entries.headline: Elevated Korea-Japan activity and six USAF transports reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported air activity near Korea and Japan at 2.5 times normal and six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne across the Atlantic and over Europe.

entries.headline: Six US transports and five coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six large US military transport aircraft airborne, including one over the North Sea, and five coded US Air Force radio broadcasts heard that day, with the latest several hours earlier.

entries.headline: USAF transports, command jet and five broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft and a nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States, with five coded radio broadcasts heard that day and the latest at 04:11 UTC.

entries.headline: USAF transports over Atlantic and North Sea reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the Atlantic and North Sea, with one coded radio broadcast heard in the preceding hour.

entries.headline: Six USAF cargo jets and two coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six large US Air Force cargo aircraft airborne and two coded radio broadcasts detected in the preceding hour, describing transport activity over the country as unusually high.

entries.headline: Elevated coded traffic and two command jets reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported coded US Air Force radio broadcasts at nearly four times normal across nine global regions from the Middle East to the Asia-Pacific, with two nuclear command aircraft airborne over the United States.
